```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="search-common.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="text-search.css">

<style>
h1.title {
  display: none;
}

#scriptureTextSearchApp .gb-scripture-rule {
  grid-template-columns:
    minmax(130px, 1fr)
    minmax(180px, 1.2fr)
    minmax(150px, 1.5fr)
    auto;
}

#scriptureTextSearchApp .gb-scripture-options {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 16px 24px;
  margin-top: 18px;
}

#scriptureTextSearchApp .gb-scripture-options .gb-field {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

#scriptureTextSearchApp #scriptureLogic {
  width: auto;
  max-width: 100%;
}

#scriptureTextSearchApp .gb-sort-wrap {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  max-width: 100%;
  gap: 8px 12px;
}

#scriptureTextSearchApp .gb-sort-wrap label {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

#scriptureTextSearchApp #scripturePageSize {
  flex: 0 0 90px;
  width: 90px;
}
#scriptureTextSearchApp #scriptureStatus {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
}

@media (max-width: 800px) {
  #scriptureTextSearchApp .gb-scripture-rule {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  #scriptureTextSearchApp .gb-scripture-rule {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
</style>

<div class="gb-search-shell" id="scriptureTextSearchApp">

<nav class="gb-search-nav" aria-label="Search tools">
<a class="gb-search-nav__link" href="https://www.mygospelbuddy.com/search/">Scripture Reference Search</a>
<a class="gb-search-nav__link gb-search-nav__link--active" aria-current="page" href="https://www.mygospelbuddy.com/search/scriptures">Scripture Text Search</a>
<a class="gb-search-nav__link" href="https://www.mygospelbuddy.com/search/words">Conference Text Search</a>
</nav>

<section class="gb-search-card gb-search-card--search">

<div class="gb-status gb-status--info"
     id="scriptureStatus"
     role="status"
     aria-live="polite">
Loading and caching verse data… This may take a moment.
</div>

<form id="scriptureForm">

<div id="scriptureFilters" aria-label="Search filters"></div>

<div class="gb-btn-row">
<button type="button" class="gb-btn gb-btn--secondary" id="scriptureAdd">Add filter</button>
</div>

<div class="gb-scripture-options">
<div class="gb-field">
<label class="gb-field__label" for="scriptureLogic">Combine filters</label>
<select class="gb-select" id="scriptureLogic">
<option value="all">AND — match all filters</option>
<option value="any">OR — match any filter</option>
</select>
</div>

<label class="gb-checkbox" for="scriptureCase">
<input type="checkbox" id="scriptureCase">
<span>Match case exactly</span>
</label>
</div>

<div class="gb-btn-row">
<button type="submit" class="gb-btn gb-btn--primary" id="scriptureSearch" disabled>Search</button>
<button type="button" class="gb-btn gb-btn--secondary" id="scriptureClear">Clear</button>
<button type="button" class="gb-btn gb-btn--secondary" id="scriptureRetry" hidden>Retry loading data</button>
</div>

</form>

<details class="gb-scripture-help">
<summary>Search tips and examples</summary>

<p><strong>Contains phrase</strong> searches the words together; quotation marks are unnecessary. Try <em>loved the world</em>. Use <strong>Contains all words</strong> or <strong>Contains any word</strong> for separate whole words.</p>

<p><strong>Wildcards:</strong> use <code>*</code> for zero or more characters and <code>?</code> for one character within a word. Try <code>lov*</code> or <code>fai?h</code>. Wildcards match entire words; for a word followed by punctuation, use a trailing <code>*</code>. Other conditions treat <code>*</code> and <code>?</code> literally.</p>

<p>For example, combine <strong>Verse text contains phrase: loved the world</strong> AND <strong>Book equals: John</strong>. To search an entire collection, try <strong>Overall book equals: Book of Mormon</strong>.</p>

<p><strong>AND</strong> requires every filter to match. <strong>OR</strong> requires at least one filter to match. To restrict a text search to a particular overall book or book, choose AND.</p>

<p>Results stay in scripture order. Highlights show matching text with nearby context. Overall book or Book filters, and exclusions, show a short verse preview when there is no positive text match.</p>
</details>

<noscript>Enable JavaScript to search the scriptures.</noscript>

</section>

<section class="gb-results" id="scriptureResults" aria-label="Search results" hidden>

<div class="gb-results__header gb-toolbar">
<h2 class="gb-search-card__title" id="scriptureCount">Matching scriptures</h2>

<div class="gb-sort-wrap">
<label for="scripturePageSize">Rows per page</label>
<select class="gb-select" id="scripturePageSize">
<option value="25" selected>25</option>
<option value="50">50</option>
<option value="100">100</option>
</select>
</div>
</div>

<div class="gb-table-wrap">
<table class="gb-table">
<caption class="sr-only">Matching scripture references and highlighted excerpts</caption>
<thead>
<tr>
<th scope="col">Reference</th>
<th scope="col">Matching text and context</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody id="scriptureRows"></tbody>
</table>
</div>

<nav class="gb-scripture-pager" aria-label="Results pages">
<button type="button" class="gb-btn gb-btn--secondary" id="scripturePrevious">Previous</button>
<span id="scripturePage" aria-live="polite"></span>
<button type="button" class="gb-btn gb-btn--secondary" id="scriptureNext">Next</button>
</nav>

</section>
</div>

<script src="text-engine.js"></script>

<script>
(function () {
  const engine = window.ScriptureTextEngine;

  const fields = {
    text: 'Verse text',
    overall_book: 'Overall book',
    book: 'Book'
  };

  const conditions = {
    contains: 'Contains phrase',
    notContains: 'Does not contain phrase',
    starts: 'Begins with',
    ends: 'Ends with',
    equals: 'Equals',
    notEquals: 'Does not equal',
    allWords: 'Contains all words',
    anyWords: 'Contains any words',
    wildcard: 'Matches wildcard words'
  };

  function limitOptions(existing, allowed) {
    Object.keys(existing).forEach(function (name) {
      delete existing[name];
    });

    Object.assign(existing, allowed);
  }

  limitOptions(engine.fields, fields);
  limitOptions(engine.textOps, conditions);

  // Book fields previously defaulted to Equals.
  // Use Contains phrase now that Equals has been removed.
  document.getElementById('scriptureFilters')
    .addEventListener('change', function (event) {
      const row = event.target.closest('.gb-scripture-rule');
      if (!row) return;

      const condition = row.querySelector('select[id^="scriptureOp"]');

      if (condition && !condition.value) {
        condition.value = 'contains';
      }
    });
})();
</script>

<script src="text-search.js"></script>
```
